loose_ends.what: standards.sgit.ai says there is no GDPR graph, while sgit.ai publishes a Standards Atlas GDPR vault that models GDPR as a navigable graph.
loose_ends.status_note: standards.sgit.ai (v0.1.4, 24 August 2026) says "There is no GDPR graph" and "THERE IS NO GDPR VAULT AND NO GDPR GRAPH". sgit.ai's published-vaults list dates the GDPR vault 25 August 2026, a day later. sgit.ai's partnership-risk brief flagged it on 24 September: "One of them needs updating".
